content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge weighs the challenger's pressing of the Isaiah 7:14 link, which rests on the sign's bounds (7:16, 8:3-4, 8:8) footed in the challenger's chain, and decides it by whether the sign states the mechanism, which is the stating-verse test the rule retires.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the sign itself does not state the mechanism", "rule_words": "the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires", "room": "Whether the challenger's bounds (Isaiah 7:16, 8:3-4) count as 'the pressing side's own chain' or as isolated verses; I read them as the challenger's chain, since DR3 footed Link 6 on them as a chain of bounds, though the judge may have meant them as single verses.", "why": "The judge decides the Isaiah 7:14 link on the ground that the sign itself does not state the mechanism, a verse-by-verse test, rather than weighing the defender's 8:8 and 9:6-7 footing against the challenger's bounds chain by footing."}
